oil.when: 2017–2023 Pacifica and Pacifica Hybrid minivan with push-button start (cluster menu method)
steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have actually been changed.
Without touching the brake pedal, press ENGINE START/STOP so the ignition is in ON/RUN. Do not start the van.
Use the arrow buttons on the steering wheel to reach the Vehicle Info screen in the cluster, then the left or right arrow to open Oil Life.
Press and hold OK until the oil life reads 100%.
Press the up arrow to leave the menu. Start the van and check that the oil change message is gone; if it is back, repeat the steps.
oil.note: The 2023 Hybrid guide says to finish within about a minute of switching the ignition on, with the engine off. Checked in the 2017 Pacifica owner's manual and the 2023 Pacifica Hybrid manual.

oil.when: 2023 Pacifica Hybrid, backup method if the menu reset does not work (accelerator pedal)
steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have actually been changed.
Without touching the brake pedal, put the ignition in ON/RUN. Do not start the van.
Slowly push the accelerator pedal all the way down and let it up, three times, all within about 10 seconds.
Without touching the brake pedal, switch the ignition off.
Start the van. If the oil change message comes back, the reset did not take, so repeat the steps.

tpms.when: 2017 Pacifica minivan (no reset button; the light clears itself)
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the driver's door jamb sticker, using your own gauge.
Drive normally. The system reads the new pressures by itself, which can take up to about 20 minutes of driving above 15 mph.
The light goes out only once every tire is at or above the sticker pressure. There is no button or menu reset.
tpms.note: If the light flashes for about 75 seconds at start-up and then stays on, that is a system fault, not low air, and setting pressures will not clear it.
